messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — Fjordly preview (acct: fjordly) is stuck on the API key step, trial access expires Tue 03/30. Need a short enablement + feedback loop plan so they don't churn. Can we nudge and run a live pairing session? cc @Raj @Tess

Raj (Solutions Eng): I can pair Wed morning PT. Do we have their error logs? last curl shows 401. Ask them to paste response headers or share request id.

Tess (CSM): I can run a 45m workshop after Raj pairs — cover quickstart, embeddings, and prompt examples. I'll prepare a 1-pager with action items. Suggested slots: Wed 9am PT / Thu 11am PT.

Devon (Onboarding): Adding onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.internal/onboard-checklists/fjordly (private) — they still need 2 seats assigned and service account role. I'll ping the customer now.

Maria (CS): Customer said they hit 'invalid key' after following docs. Raj, here's the curl they ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
```
They used the UI key not the service one. Can we confirm dev policy?

Raj (Solutions Eng): Yep that's the issue. UI keys aren't valid for programmatic access. I'll draft a micro-step for them to create a service key + minimal RBAC. Will post the snippet.

Raj (Solutions Eng): Snippet:
```
# create key
open ./console -> Integrations -> Service Keys -> Create
# use key in env
export REDWOOD_KEY=sk-...
```
I'll DM the customer after the workshop.

Tess (CSM): :thumbsup: I'll set calendar invite once Raj confirms Wed 9am PT. Can we also collect 3 short prompts to use as evals in-session?

Maria (CS): Yes — ask them to send 3 representative use-case prompts pre-call. Also we need a quick CS health check: current usage = 0, seats invited = 0, NPS flagged? Their renewal is Oct but if they can't get data in preview they may deprioritize.

Devon (Onboarding): Pinged Fjordly contact (eva@fjordly.co). She replied 'can do Wed 9am PT' and will send prompts. I also requested their IAM screenshot.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: Fjordly pairing workshop Wed 09:00 PT — calendar invite to be sent by Tess.

Tess (CSM): Invite sent to eva@fjordly.co + raj + maria + devon. Title: 'Fjordly Preview: Quickstart & Feedback Workshop' — agenda in invite. :calendar: 

Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare two short demos: embeddings similarity and low-latency chat. Plan to instrument a small eval harness so we can capture qualitative feedback live.

Maria (CS): Action items: Raj = pairing + key snippet + demo, Tess = invite + 1-pager + collect prompts, Devon = confirm seats + IAM, Maria = confirmation email + renewal risk note. I'll update SFDC. Please drop a one-line summary after the call.

Eva (Fjordly): Thanks all! Wed 9am PT works. I'll send 3 prompts and attach IAM screenshot. Appreciate the help :)

Tess (CSM): Perfect — see you Wednesday. If anything changes ping here. :rocket: 

Maria (CS): Marked as 'high touch' in tracker. Closing pre-call ops, will reopen thread with post-call notes. :white_check_mark:
